lines.say: Sir said, write I will not talk, a hundred times!
lines.cap: Sir said: write 'I will not talk' 100 times!

lines.say: A hundred times? Python does it in two lines! Meet the for loop!
lines.cap: 100 times? Python does it in 2 lines! Meet the for loop!

lines.say: Range three gives three numbers. The loop runs once for each!
lines.cap: range(3) gives 3 numbers. The loop runs once for each!

lines.say: Wait, why does it start at zero?
lines.cap: Wait, why does it start at 0?

lines.say: Range starts at zero, and stops before the end! Want one to three? Write range one, four!
lines.cap: range starts at 0 and stops BEFORE the end! Want 1 to 3? Write range(1, 4)!

lines.say: Your turn! Pause, and predict! What prints?
lines.cap: Your turn! Pause and predict! What prints?

lines.say: Six! One plus two plus three!
Yes! Four is never included, so it's not ten!
lines.cap: Yes! 4 is never included, so it's not 10!
